svg.title: Turn Search Demand into Owned Publishing Assets
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-search-portfolio-production-loop; chart type: process_flow; title: Turn Search Demand into Owned Publishing Assets; subtitle: Five operating stages connect useful pages to publisher revenue.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operating sequence covers multi-site search publishing, selective programmatic production, and GEO citation tracking. Stage numbers express sequence, not revenue forecasts. The canonical time to first deal is 3–12 months.; caption: Automate technical audits, refresh queues, and revenue reporting; retain human responsibility for evidence, rights, and editorial quality.; stages: label: Map demand; value: Stage 1: select defensible topic clusters; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Combine Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and direct SERP inspection to map intent, competing formats, audience needs, and plausible advertising or affiliate demand.; label: Design assets; value: Stage 2: establish evidence and page architecture; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Specify original research, licensed media, internal links, and differentiated page templates. Reject programmatic variants that add no substantive user value.; label: Publish and verify; value: Stage 3: release tested editorial units; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use Screaming Frog and Search Console to inspect status codes, canonicals, rendering, and indexability. Editors verify claims, contributor rights, and commercial disclosures.; label: Monetize earned attention; value: Stage 4: connect approved commercial relationships; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Record advertising earnings, approved affiliate commissions, and delivered sponsorship revenue. Exclude referred merchant sales, pending commissions, and undelivered sponsor commitments.; label: Refresh and package; value: Stage 5: reinvest using auditable asset records; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Queue decaying pages in Airtable; reconcile revenue in BigQuery and Looker Studio. Log sampled GEO citations separately from referrals and maintain transfer-ready rights records.

text.title: Turn Search Demand into Owned Publishing Assets
text.tspan: Turn Search Demand into Owned Publishing Assets

circle.title: label: Map demand; value: Stage 1: select defensible topic clusters; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Combine Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and direct SERP inspection to map intent, competing formats, audience needs, and plausible advertising or affiliate demand.

text.title: Combine Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and direct SERP inspection to map intent, competing formats, audience needs, and plausible advertising or affiliate demand.

circle.title: label: Design assets; value: Stage 2: establish evidence and page architecture; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Specify original research, licensed media, internal links, and differentiated page templates. Reject programmatic variants that add no substantive user value.

text.title: Specify original research, licensed media, internal links, and differentiated page templates. Reject programmatic variants that add no substantive user value.

circle.title: label: Publish and verify; value: Stage 3: release tested editorial units; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use Screaming Frog and Search Console to inspect status codes, canonicals, rendering, and indexability. Editors verify claims, contributor rights, and commercial disclosures.

text.title: Use Screaming Frog and Search Console to inspect status codes, canonicals, rendering, and indexability. Editors verify claims, contributor rights, and commercial disclosures.

circle.title: label: Monetize earned attention; value: Stage 4: connect approved commercial relationships; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Record advertising earnings, approved affiliate commissions, and delivered sponsorship revenue. Exclude referred merchant sales, pending commissions, and undelivered sponsor commitments.

text.title: Record advertising earnings, approved affiliate commissions, and delivered sponsorship revenue. Exclude referred merchant sales, pending commissions, and undelivered sponsor commitments.

circle.title: label: Refresh and package; value: Stage 5: reinvest using auditable asset records; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Queue decaying pages in Airtable; reconcile revenue in BigQuery and Looker Studio. Log sampled GEO citations separately from referrals and maintain transfer-ready rights records.

text.title: Queue decaying pages in Airtable; reconcile revenue in BigQuery and Looker Studio. Log sampled GEO citations separately from referrals and maintain transfer-ready rights records.

Assumptions: The operating sequence covers multi-site search publishing, selective programmatic production, and GEO citation tracking. Stage numbers express sequence, not revenue forecasts. The canonical time to first deal is 3–12 months.
